title: Volume 2 Chapter 11: Valkyries of the Boots Cat
content: As I waited inside the transport aircraft, dressed in my pilot suit, Dr. Allison hurriedly boarded with the development staff.
"Dr. Allison?"
"We're deploying. A reinforcement request has come from the Second Academy."
"...Understood."
I never thought Lieutenant Hayase's intuition would actually be right.
Dr. Allison's expression was more serious than usual.
"Also, a Special Class has been confirmed. It seems the Second Academy is engaging it, but there's a possibility of combat if things go poorly."
"Special Class!?"
I instinctively lifted myself from my chair.
Special Classes are stronger than First Classes and cause significant damage.
There have been numerous instances where a Special Class appeared in a city and was blown away without a trace.
I had seen the materials about them many times during training.
Dr. Allison tossed me a tablet and instructed me to review the information.
"It's a massive Gijuu known as a Wide Area Destruction Type. There's a chance we might have to deal with it, so make sure to memorize the details. Also, keep an eye on the battlefield situation."
I had memorized the information about the Toto Dino during my training.
It's a giant, disc-shaped Gijuu, protected by a hard outer shell on top.
It attacks by firing lasers and beams from the bottom, and it's a Special Class that is simply large and extremely difficult to destroy.
However, as I checked, I found that there was no detailed information about the battlefield.
It seemed true that the Second Academy was in dire straits due to enemy reinforcements, but I couldn't glean anything more.
After finishing my review, I returned the tablet to Dr. Allison.
"I'll wait in the cockpit."

"Please do. And I'm sorry, but this time it will be a trial by fire again. Be careful with the new equipment, especially since we’ve only done test firing so far, and we don't know how it will perform in actual combat."
"Understood."
As I responded, Dr. Allison turned her back to me.
"...Come back safely. Without you, the Prometheus Project can't progress."
I felt that Dr. Allison was genuinely concerned for me in her own way.
To respond to that feeling, I saluted.
"If it comes down to it, I'll return with just my two daggers."
I expressed my determination to survive, but this statement backfired.
Dr. Allison turned to me, her brow furrowed.

"I can accept that if the situation is unavoidable, but I won't allow you to abandon the new equipment just because you're more comfortable with familiar weapons. That weapon is extremely delicate, and if it's discarded in the sea, it won't be usable even if recovered. Understand? I won't accept anything other than unavoidable circumstances."
It was a weapon developed with a significant budget aimed at defeating First Classes.
It wouldn't sit well with Dr. Allison if it were easily discarded.
"...I'll do my best."
However, in actual combat, anything could happen.
Not wanting to make a rash promise, I gave a vague answer, which only made Dr. Allison's expression more severe.
"I'll ultimately leave it to the pilot's judgment, but if you abandon it, you'll be writing a report as thick as a dictionary, so be prepared."
"...Yes, ma'am."
For a moment, I was overwhelmed by Dr. Allison's intensity and unintentionally responded in a foreign manner.
I recalled that the MC had said the same thing when he angered a female officer.
The Valkyries of the Boots Cat, who had been on standby, had changed into their pilot suits.
It was rare for the Second Academy to request reinforcements, so the Valkyries were bewildered.
"What kind of enemy is the Gringarm Team struggling against?"
"I heard there's a Special Class, but with two Special Equipment users, they couldn't defeat it?"
"Anyway, we need to hurry and change."
Everyone was unsettled by the sudden deployment, thinking they would be safe with the Second Academy.
Among them, Megumi was also changing into her pilot suit.
Without speaking to anyone, she was battling the fear of standing on the front lines as a true Valkyrie.
(If I had known it would come to this, I should have retired sooner.)
In a situation where she felt isolated within the unit, her survival rate would drastically decrease.
At worst, there was even a possibility of being shot from behind by other Valkyries who disliked her.
Though she had sown the seeds of this situation herself, Megumi couldn't help but feel terrified about deploying.
(I thought I could become an elite by becoming a true Valkyrie.)
As her hands trembled and she struggled to change into her pilot suit, Maya passed by her without even glancing at her.
"Doesn't she even notice me? If only that person..."
Despairing at the indifference of her training officer, Megumi began to tremble with anger when Suzuka came over and wrapped her arm around her shoulder.
Suzuka pulled Megumi closer to her.
"Hey, traitor."
"W-What is it?"
Suzuka shot a cold glare at Megumi, who looked frightened.
"Don't do anything stupid. If you shoot Hayase from behind, I'll shoot you down immediately."
"W-Wait, aren't you supposed to hate each other?"
"Yeah, I do. I absolutely hate Hayase. I can't stand that she took the ace position and the Special Equipment from Mai. But... she's our ace."
There was no lie in Suzuka's words.
As Megumi nodded small in response, Suzuka released her.
"Don't worry about what's behind you. We won't do anything stupid like shooting a foolish newcomer from behind. Just focus on fighting ahead."
With that, Suzuka left the locker room with her subordinates.
Before she knew it, Megumi's trembling hands had stopped.
Looking at her hands, Megumi said,
"What’s this? There's a sense of camaraderie after all."
On the first day of their meeting, they had shown their animosity, so she thought Maya would be isolated in actual combat as well.
But in reality, the Boots Cat trusted Maya when it came to fighting.
After finishing changing, Megumi left the locker room.
Inside the transport aircraft carrying the Boots Cat, Mio stood with her arms crossed.
"Everyone from Boots Cat! The Gringarm Team has called for help. We've caused enough trouble for everyone so far, so let's help them this time!"
As Mio delivered her heartfelt words to her students, Kagami stepped forward from the back.
"Special Class and a large number of enemy reinforcements have appeared from the medium-sized gate. This gate is unprecedented, and we are in a situation where we cannot let our guard down."
The lined-up Valkyries listened to Kagami's explanation with serious expressions.
Even Maya, who usually displayed a lack of motivation, was attentive.

"Your objective is to enter the communication disruption area of the gate, join up with the Second Academy, and destroy the gate. If the Special Class is still alive, prioritize its defeat. After that—it's up to your judgment on the battlefield."
Kagami glanced at the floating island, nodded slightly, and then turned back to the Valkyries.

"You heard that, right? We're heading to rescue the Second Academy. And unfortunately, it seems we don't have the luxury of letting the newcomers play around. Asai, Nishitani, and Suzuki will be left to Hayase."
Maya, who was entrusted with them, looked slightly dissatisfied.
"I think it would be better to guard the transport aircraft. I have my robot, so I don't need to worry about support."
She protested, but Kagami wouldn't budge.
"The development team for that robot has contacted us, expressing concerns about its armament. It's an order. Think of taking care of the newcomers as part of their training."
"Okay..."
Maya responded with a lack of enthusiasm, turning her gaze to the three nervous newcomers.
"Just don't get in my way."
That was hardly the words of someone entrusted with training newcomers.
Seeing this, Kagami let out a small sigh and turned her gaze to Mio.
Mio shook her head in concern and tightened her expression.
"Alright, everyone onboard! We're going in to rescue the Gringarm Team!"
Maya complied with Mio's command, but let out an exaggerated sigh.
"...Mio's encouragement is so deflating."
Maya inadvertently revealed her true feelings, and the other Valkyries subtly agreed.
As everyone donned their Valkyrie Dresses, Kagami approached Maya and spoke.
"Maya, your attendant has already entered deployment preparation. Once you go outside, gather the three of them and join up."
"Understood. It's my first time fighting alongside them, but I expect great things."
As Maya, now equipped with the Special Equipment Valkyrie Dress, said this, Kagami looked at the three newcomers who were nervously struggling to put on their equipment.
"Take care of the other three as well. If you favor them too much, he might attract jealousy from others and become uncomfortable."
Receiving Kagami's advice, Maya smiled faintly.
"Those three are different from him, Kyou-chan."
"...I see. Do as you like."
Kagami realized that anything she said would be in vain and moved to help the bewildered newcomers.
"Thunderbolt's restraints have been confirmed released."
"Magical power output is within acceptable range, with a deviation of one percent. Output stable."
"Confirmed reduction of the aircraft's weight due to magical power."
Inside the transport aircraft's hangar, preparations for the Thunderbolt's deployment were underway.
"Is this the only thing prepared besides the main railgun?"
The light machine gun fixed to the left wall of the hangar had drum magazines attached to both sides.
Perhaps anticipating close encounters, a blade was attached beneath the muzzle like a bayonet.
Since it hadn't been used in actual combat, its performance was also unknown.
"It seems manageable, but the problem lies with the main weapon..."

The railgun, fixed to the left and right capacitors on the back of the Thunderbolt, was a makeshift creation that was cumbersome to handle even when stored, and energy cables were forcibly attached to the left and right capacitors to supply magical power and electricity.
"I wonder how well it will perform in actual combat."
It was difficult to handle, and I had been handed a manual as thick as a dictionary to use it.
Dr. Allison and the others had developed the software, but it felt like too much trouble to use it in actual combat.
It seemed that Dr. Smith noticed my doubts and approached me with interest.
"Are you negative about the railgun, Envy?"
"No, I'm convinced it's the optimal solution for defeating First Classes. However, I was just considering whether I could operate it smoothly in actual combat. I apologize for my rude statement."
"That's fine. More importantly, it seems there are many First Classes on this battlefield. It's perfect for testing the new equipment."
Dr. Smith was fascinated by the power of the new equipment fixed to my right arm and shoulder due to its size.
However, what Dr. Smith was truly interested in was whether the Thunderbolt and I could defeat a First Class.
As the Thunderbolt held the light machine gun in its left hand, it moved to the next stage.
"Deployment preparations are complete. We're ready whenever."
When Dr. Allison gave the go-ahead, the signal lights in the hangar changed from red to blue.
"Ignition!"
As the jet engine started and thrust increased, the Thunderbolt, now lighter due to magical power, began to rise.
It was fixed to a cable that also served as a fuel pipe extending from the hangar wall, but as the thrust increased, the restraints reached their durability limit and released.
As the Thunderbolt broke free from the transport aircraft's hangar, an alarm sounded from the communication line.
It wasn't from the Thunderbolt, but from the transport aircraft.
"Dr. Smith? Dr. Allison!?"
As I checked the transport aircraft while enduring the weight in the cockpit, Dr. Smith's carefree voice explained the situation.
"The restraints blew off. This transport aircraft was hastily modified, so it was bound to break down if used continuously."
"I'm glad to hear you're safe."
Pushing Dr. Smith aside, Dr. Allison spoke to me.
"Don't worry about us. Just think about yourself."
"Understood."
The Thunderbolt's destination was the transport aircraft carrying the Boots Cat.
As I headed there, the Valkyries in their Valkyrie Dresses were being deployed one after another from the transport aircraft, free-falling into the air.
They spread their wings like sub-arms in mid-air, regaining their posture.
They then grouped together by squad, forming formations.
"Over there."
Among the Valkyrie Dresses, the most prominent was Lieutenant Hayase's Special Equipment.
As the Thunderbolt approached, she turned around and flew backward towards us.
"We managed to regroup properly. Should I praise you for that?"
"Is this the level of praise for someone suspected of not being able to regroup?"
I was surprised at my low evaluation when Lieutenant Hayase laughed.
"It was a joke."
As she turned back to face forward, I noticed the three newcomers who were floundering, unsure of how to form a formation.
"Lieutenant Hayase."
When I called out, she sighed before speaking.
"Everyone, don't worry about the formation and fly freely. We're not expecting coordination from a makeshift squad. I have only one order for you—do what you need to do. That's all."
As Lieutenant Hayase issued her command, Nishitani shouted.
"Alright!! Then I'm going to be the first!"
Though usually shy and indecisive, she transformed into a completely different person after donning the Valkyrie Dress.
Her first-person pronoun changed from "watashi" to "ore," and her face was filled with confidence and combativeness.
Ignoring the formation, she flew ahead alone, prompting Asai and Suzuki to shout.
"Wait!"
"Going alone is reckless!"
Then, Lieutenant Hayase began to laugh.
"That's nice. You're not the same person as usual. I like interesting people. But... I also love being the first!"
As she finished speaking, she accelerated and overtook Nishitani.
Unlike the training machines used by the Fifth Academy, the real Valkyrie Dress was high-performance.
And the Special Equipment had even greater capabilities.
"What incredible acceleration."
I accelerated the Thunderbolt to keep up, but the distance between us gradually widened.
Nishitani, who had been overtaken, shouted.
"That insane acceleration! Give me that Special Equipment!"
"You're quite spirited. Then try to take the ace position from me. If you do, this one will be yours from now on."
"I'll do it!!"
Hearing the conversation between the two ahead, Asai seemed to give up.
"I can't keep up in so many ways... Suzuki, and Ichinose, why don't we form a formation just the two of us?"
Surprised, Suzuki looked at Asai.
"Huh!? Are we really going to rely on someone like her?"
"Do you think we can survive isolated on a battlefield with a Special Class?"
"Ugh! Well, that's..."
Asai's suggestion was also welcome to me.
The current Thunderbolt had few weapons, and I hadn't even done a test fire with the new equipment.
Cooperating with them would likely be the key to surviving this battle.
"I'm fine with that. However, I usually take evasive actions, so if you get too close, I might get in your way."
Suzuki seemed to have doubts about my fighting style.
"Avoiding? With that much armor?"
I understood what she was trying to say.
The Thunderbolt was heavily armored compared to the Valkyrie Dresses of the Valkyries.
Its robust and sturdy appearance likely suggested a combat style that could withstand enemy attacks.
However, the truth was the opposite.
"I'm cutting the magical power allocated for defense, so the current Thunderbolt is just a metal lump. It's powerless against Gijuu's attacks."
When I stated the facts, Asai looked perplexed.
"...So it's paper-thin despite that appearance."
"Yes."
When I confirmed that her understanding was correct, Suzuki yelled.
"So you're saying it has few weapons and can't even serve as a shield... Are you really okay teaming up with someone like that?"
At the location of the medium-sized gate, a massive disc floated above the sea.
"Hah... Hah..."
Standing atop the Special Class, struggling to catch her breath, was Kiyone in her Valkyrie Dress.
She had been equipped with missile pods, but they had been destroyed, leaving her wrist and beyond nonexistent.
The sub-arm on her left arm, which held the Dragonfly Slash—her ultimate railgun—was also emitting black smoke, likely at its limit from continuous use.
The sub-arm itself was reaching its limit, and the joints were making strange noises and refusing to move.
Without hesitation, Kiyone abandoned the Dragonfly Slash along with the sub-arm.
The only remaining weapon was a single katana held by Kiyone.
As if answering her, her comrades descended.
"Kiyone!"
"Do you have any spare weapons? Ammo!?"
To her comrades' inquiries, Kiyone revealed her frustration with a pained expression.
"My sub-arm is useless. Plus, the container was filled with ammo and railgun projectiles, so all I have left is this sword..."
As the two who had landed checked Kiyone's condition, they looked up at the sky with pale faces.
They were standing on the corpse of the Special Class they had somehow defeated.
Yet, there were no smiles on their faces.
When Kiyone looked up at the sky, there were Gijuu flying around them.
While it would have been fine if there were several below First Class, the troublesome part was the large number of First Classes.
Flying in circles above the corpse of the Special Class alongside the Baooga were the mid-range combat-specialized First Class Gijuu.
They were called "Eagle Boars," resembling large four-legged beasts.
However, their four legs were shaped like wings.
Despite their structure, which should have made flying impossible, they soared gracefully through the air.
Their bodies resembled a hornless rhinoceros, but like the Baooga, glowing objects peeked out from the gaps in their shells.
These glimmers moved like the eyes of living creatures.
Compared to the Baooga, their shells were fewer and thinner, and their force field defenses were likely weaker for a First Class.
However, the reason Eagle Boars were classified as First Class was due to their high attack capabilities compared to the Baooga.
For the Valkyries of the Gringarm Team, they were a troublesome opponent.
The Gijuu were flying in circles around the Valkyries standing on the corpse of the Special Class, gradually narrowing their range to prevent their escape.
As Reona descended beside Kiyone, she too was drenched in sweat.
Reona, with her wet hair slicked back, asked Kiyone,
"I'm sorry for asking after the limit release, but can you still fight, Kiyone?"
Kiyone stabbed her katana into the corpse of the Special Class to stand up.
"I can still do it..."
Seeing Kiyone wobble, Reona shook her head.

"Don't lie. You were taught to provide accurate information when reporting, right? In that case, I'll take charge here. Everyone else, fall back and regroup. If all goes well, we should be able to join up with the Boots Cat."
Reona seemed to believe that Ichika and the others were requesting reinforcements and intended to take the rear alone.
Hearing this, Kiyone and the other Valkyries turned pale.
Kiyone gathered strength in her legs and readied her chipped katana.
To show Reona that she could still fight.
"I'll stay! You don't need to stay, Reona. Besides... I'm still okay."
Reona's eyes widened at Kiyone's insistence to take the rear.
"Kiyone?"
"I request permission to release the limit once more."
Kiyone sent a limit release request to Reona.
A screen displaying whether to approve the release appeared before Reona, forcing her to make a choice.
"If you release the limit multiple times in a day, even you—"
As she tried to refuse, Kiyone soared into the sky.
"—Then I'll just keep repeating the limit release."
"That's reckless! The cooldown for limit release—"
As Reona refused, Kiyone turned her gaze to the other Valkyries.
"Get back quickly!"
As the Valkyries, against Reona's will, forcibly attached themselves to her and soared into the sky.
"You guys!?"
As the group of Valkyries trying to escape was about to be attacked by the Gijuu, Kiyone flew towards them.
"I'll cut them all down!!"
Seeing Kiyone dive into the swarm of Gijuu, Reona clenched her teeth and tightened her fists.
Then, she slammed her fist onto the approval button on the screen.
At that moment, Kiyone underwent a transformation.
Her purple hair glowed and swayed, and light filled her eyes.
As the Valkyrie Dress transformed to release heat, it took on the form allowed only for Special Equipment, with the limiter removed.
"Don't think you can win against me at my full power."
Kiyone shifted her gaze to the most threatening Gijuu at that moment.
The Eagle Boar. If they were attacked in groups from mid-range, the exhausted Valkyries would have no means to fight back and would be shot down.
Determining this, Kiyone rapidly approached the group of Eagle Boars, and the eyes peeking out from the gaps in their shells all turned to her, firing beams generated by magical power.
The beams unleashed from the bodies of the Eagle Boars pursued Kiyone.
They had better tracking performance than the Baooga, and on top of that, their power was high.
If caught and beaten down, the magical force field protecting the Valkyries would soon reach its limit and be burned away.
With dozens of such troublesome Gijuu present, they had to be defeated for her comrades to escape safely.
"Don't interfere with us!!"
As Kiyone charged at the Gijuu—many of them were sliced and fell into the sea.
She flew around the Gijuu, cutting them down as she passed by.
With overwhelming performance, she forcefully secured a retreat route.
As Kiyone opened a hole in the Gijuu's encirclement, Reona and the others began to retreat.
With her voice trembling with regret, Reona said to Kiyone,
"It should be you, younger than me, who is prioritized..."
As Reona and the others broke through the encirclement and retreated, they reached an area where communication devices were effective.
However, the swarm of First Classes was closing in on Reona and her team.
They were also bringing along a group of Second Classes, seemingly intent on not letting them escape.
Seeing the pursuing Gijuu, Reona's subordinates felt a sense of urgency.
Having faced a Special Class, they had exhausted all weapons and ammunition stored in the subspace container.
It was difficult to face a First Class in this state.
Seeing the fear on her subordinates' faces, Reona smiled.
"Don't worry, little kittens. —It seems we made it just in time."
Something flew into the pursuing Gijuu.
By the time her subordinates realized it was an ally, several First Classes had already been sliced apart.
Reona turned around to see her ally.
"You came, Hayase."
The one who had dove into the swarm of Gijuu alone was Maya, wielding blades of light in both hands.
She swung the blades that emerged from her small star-shaped shield, slicing through the Gijuu.
Her appearance must have looked reassuring to her subordinates.
"The ace of Boots Cat!?"
"What a rough fighting style!"
"But for now, she's reliable."
Though her fighting style seemed instinctively aggressive against any enemy in sight, Reona could tell that Maya was fighting with a strategy.
Even if it looked chaotic, she was prioritizing the elimination of the Eagle Boars, which were the current threat.
To the exhausted Reona and her team, Maya's performance shone brightly.
While this was happening, the reinforcements caught up.
"Captain Usami, from here on out, Boots Cat will take over. Colonel Ichika is coming to pick you up with a transport aircraft, so regroup with her and retreat."
Approaching them was the former ace, Mai from the Fifth Academy.
Reona had known her longer than Maya.
"That helps. But you see, I have a precious subordinate fighting alone."
"...What's the situation?"
"There are over a hundred First Classes. I never expected them to deploy this much power from a medium-sized gate."
Upon hearing the number of First Classes, the members of Boots Cat were also taken aback.
Reona added,

"The troublesome part is that reinforcements keep coming. If we don't destroy the gate quickly, the enemy's strength will only continue to grow. I'm sorry to ask for your help, but you alone won't have enough firepower."
Reona believed that Boots Cat alone wouldn't be able to destroy the gate.
It would be more successful if they replenished their supplies and jointly attacked the gate.
In that case, she also considered that there would be considerable damage.
While the two assessed the situation, Maya, having finished annihilating the pursuing Gijuu, joined them.
When she approached Reona and checked her expression, she frowned.
"You look terrible."
"Haha, Hayase, you really hold nothing back. Also, I'm sorry, but could you help me? I want to save Kiyone, who is fighting alone to let me escape."
Understanding the situation, Maya didn't respond immediately to Reona's request.
While they were waiting, the Thunderbolt arrived.
"Lieutenant Hayase, I apologize for the delay."
The appearance of the massive humanoid weapon seemed like an alien object had mixed into the usual battlefield.
However, its large form was also mentally reassuring.
And the one piloting it was someone important to Reona.
As Reona was captivated by the Thunderbolt, Maya spoke up.
"You used the limit release, didn't you?"
It wasn't a question but a statement of fact.
Reona smiled and tried to deflect it.
"I had to show my true strength against a Special Class."
"—That's unnecessary."
"Huh?"
Maya distanced herself from Reona and addressed the Thunderbolt.
"We're heading to destroy the gate now, but what about you? If you act with me, you'll have more than enough opportunities to face the First Classes."
Ren, piloting the Thunderbolt, was puzzled by Maya's suggestion.
"If it's an order, I'll accompany you, but isn't Colonel Usami here as well?"
Wasn't he supposed to consult his superior? Concerned about that, Maya shot back.
"That's unnecessary. As long as I get permission for the limit release from the teachers, I can manage on my own."
It was Reona, not Ren, who reacted first to Maya's words.
"Hayase, are you planning to use your trump card for Kiyone? That's not acceptable. Because this is my—"
As Reona tried to refuse, Maya dismissively retorted,
"What can a Valkyrie on the verge of retirement do? Just stay back and be useless."
The rude way she spoke enraged the Valkyries of the Gringarm Team, who shouted angrily.
"The ace of Boots Cat is acting all high and mighty!"
"Your achievements are nothing compared to Sister Reona!"
"What can you do alone!?"
Seeing her subordinates' anger directed at Maya, Reona shouted.
"Stop it! We don't have time to argue. Let's leave this to Boots Cat."
While they were making noise, it seemed Maya had finished obtaining permission and left without saying anything.
The Thunderbolt seemed concerned about Reona but chased after Maya.
Watching this, Mai approached Suzuka.
"Is it alright, Mai?"
When asked by her comrades if it was okay to let Maya go, Mai seemed exasperated but decided to follow.
"Sigh... It's not okay, is it? I can't let her charge in alone. I'll leave a squad to protect them and chase after her."
As Boots Cat flew off, leaving behind a protective squad, Reona hung her head.
(Really, Hayase is sharp.)
